android.desc:
This is the Pro version of SkEye which supports:
 • Complete NGC, IC catalog with a powerful object filter
 • Custom Catalog, that can be imported from a CSV file
 • Support for Comets and Artificial Satellites.
   Note that TLE data is currently not automatically updated to avoid an extra permission: Internet access. Alternate mechanism is being designed.
 • All stars from Tycho2 catalog which goes up to mag 11.5.
 • Meteor showers, including Perseids, Geminids, Leonids

‣ Queries
Send an email to hi.skeye@gmail.com

‣ App Permissions
 • Location: to determine accurate position of celestial objects
 • Bluetooth: to support remote sensors

‣ Links
Feedback: https://skeye.uservoice.com/
Documentation: https://lavadip.com/skeye/docs.html
Google Group: https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/skeye

Just like the SkEye app, this app provides a star chart for Astronomy observations and easy PushTo guidance for Binoculars or Telescopes.

quotes.text:
I am not sure this comet deserves the title of "comet of the century" just yet, but it is still an interesting exercise to observe the comet.

(Shameless Plug) If you need help to observe the comet, my Android app [1] just recently added support for comets. What sets the app apart is that, if you have a telescope, it can guide you with a single alignment of your telescope to a nearby star.

[1] https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.lavadip.skeyepro
quotes.story_title: Ison: The comet of the century
